name: 20522-longprefill-qwen3next80b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, unquantized. ~152 GB of weights, ~19 GB per rank at TP8.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, one whole a3 node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 384 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN: 10000 prompt tokens (stdev 0) against exactly 128 output tokens (stdev 0), unique prompts with no shared prefix (prefix_tokens 0), seed 0.
purpose: An 80-billion-parameter document analyst digesting 10,000-token reports into short answers for 16 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED silently.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

tp-size: 8

# Not the default: `--mamba-scheduler-strategy` defaults to `auto`, which resolves to `no_buffer`.
# Requires the radix cache left enabled -- `--disable-radix-cache` raises outright.
mamba-scheduler-strategy: extra_buffer

# The engine's own H100 auto-default, written down rather than inherited.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

cuda-graph-max-bs: 64

random-seed: 0
